title: Repeat Missed-Visit Fees and the Appointment Series No-Show Fee
content:
Patient financial policy — repeat share in the no-show fee on an Appointment Series.

**Clause.** The no-show repeat share is 150 percent where the series already shows two or more missed-visit fees assessed in the two months up to the assessment date (an entry counts when fewer than two whole months separate its date from the assessment date), 125 percent where it shows exactly one such fee, and 100 percent where it shows none. The share is read as a percentage of the no-show basis and multiplies it.

**What is counted.** The missed-visit fee entries already standing on the same series — late-cancellation and no-show fee entries alike — each dated on the date it was assessed.

**Condition — result.**

- Two or more such fee entries in the period: 150 percent.
- Exactly one: 125 percent.
- None: 100 percent.

**At the edge of the period (hypothetical dates, assessment on 15 June).** A fee entry dated 16 April counts, since fewer than two whole months separate it from 15 June; a fee entry dated 15 April does not.

**Example (hypothetical figures).** A no-show basis of USD 50.00 on a series already showing one fee entry in the period: 125 percent of USD 50.00 is USD 62.50.
